Moore deems AMD's "Ryzen" parts to have missed some opportunity by not hitting the right numbers for "single-threaded" performance: As we wrote earlier in the year, we don't think that AMD has gotten as much traction as they had hoped from the enthusiast gaming market. While Ryzen did meet the performance benchmarks that AMD claimed, making it a solid choice for workstations using highly threaded applications, the single threaded gaming performance has underwhelmed.
